b: Mat Colegate uses an unutterable, indescribable, cosmically horrific dialectic to suss out why so many great films have come out of such problematic source material

How to solve a problem like Howard Phillips Lovecraft? As an author he is maybe second only to Tolkien in the extraordinary reach of his influence on pop culture, with a legacy that encompasses literary prizes, beanie toys and band names, not to mention a reputation as one of the foundational architects of the weird fiction genre. He was a tormented but highly imaginative writer whose best work often displays a prophetic edge; he was the cultural figure aside from Shakespeare with the most recognisable silhouette; and, as even the casually acquainted with his stories...
